title: 愛する人へ
html:
My life changed, for the better, on 28th April 2024.

The day I proposed to you, my love.

Since that moment, I knew I had made one of the best decisions of my life.

I feel so lucky to have you, to enjoy moments with you, and to have such a loving partner.

But more than that, I am always happy because I know you are a lifelong best friend.

I’ve said this before and I’ll say it again: your laughter ignites a chemical explosion in my heart: equally funny, equally awesome and lovely for me.

Never stop smiling. Your smile is like sunshine for my heart.

Love you forever.
